title: Show the upload date under each title on the library list
objective: On the library list, show each document's upload date under its title, like "Uploaded Sep 30", in the row's meta (an element with data-testid="uploaded" inside each data-testid="doc-row"). Dates are UTC; an earlier year shows the year.
acceptance: Every library row shows its upload date under the title
d1 reads "Uploaded Sep 30" and d3 reads "Uploaded Sep 12"
An earlier year shows the year, like "Uploaded Dec 31, 2025"
plan_summary: formatDate in format.mjs; render it in each row of libraryPage.
